expected: uses bounded local fields
preserves physical scale
does not substitute a whole-organ view

expected: audits mesh availability
records segment ids and coordinate convention

requires physical resolution

uses eased physical-coordinate poses

expected: skips conversion
checks info bounds and sample reads
writes state json and viewer url
